[EN] My name is Loomey.

I enjoy wandering the land.
[ES] Me llamo Loomey.

Disfruto vagando por estas tierras.

[EN] Would you take a look at this egg? I found it in the Timeless Woods.
[ES] ¿Podrías echarle un vistazo a este huevo? Lo encontré en Timeless Woods.

[EN] I hope everything goes well.
[ES] Espero que todo salga bien.
